messages.text:
Hi Jess,
I’m really interested in the room in Spring Hill — the house sounds lovely and I really like the mix of people and the community vibe you’ve described.
A little about me: I’m 22 from the UK on a working holiday visa and currently working in Brisbane as a bartender. I’m clean, respectful and easygoing, and I enjoy a social home where people can chat and connect, but also respect each other’s space. Outside of work I like going to the gym, running and exploring the city.
I noticed the listing mentions a 4-month minimum stay, so I just wanted to check if there might be any flexibility with that, as I’m currently looking for somewhere for around 2-3 months while I settle into Brisbane.
If that could work, I’d love to arrange a time to come and see the place.
Thanks,
Jasmine
